description: Rows from the LexAPI corpus matching filters — e.g. regulations dated 2024 or documents whose text changed since a date. BUSINESS plans and above (403 otherwise). Cost: 1 credit per row returned, at least 1 per call. The call is admitted for 1 credit, the matching rows are counted, and the rest of 1 credit per row it can return (up to limit) is reserved; if the pool cannot cover that, LexAPI answers 402 before returning anything (retry with a smaller limit). Reserved credits for rows not returned are refunded. Keep limit small. An export that fails part-way is reported as incomplete, never as a result. Bulk export for ML training needs a separate licence (Terms §6).

author.description: Stored author values, matched whole and ignoring case (a joint act's "European Parliament, Council of the European Union" is one value).

changedSince.description: Only rows whose text changed at or after this time — the cheapest incremental sync. ISO 8601: a date (YYYY-MM-DD, midnight UTC) or a date-time with a timezone.

documentType.description: Stored document-type labels, matched exactly but ignoring case, e.g. ["Regulation","Directive"]: "regulation" matches Regulation, not Implementing regulation (use documentTypeCode for the family).

documentTypeCode.description: Type families by documentTypeCode, e.g. ["regulation"] — includes implementing and delegated regulations. Combined with documentType, both must match.

fetchedSince.description: Only rows written to at or after this time (any update, including metadata-only). Prefer changedSince for syncing text. ISO 8601: a date (YYYY-MM-DD, midnight UTC) or a date-time with a timezone.

includeContent.description: Include each row's parsed body (bounded by maxChars).

includeStubs.description: Also rows whose text EUR-Lex does not publish.

language.description: Language: ISO 639-1 code of an official EU language (en, fr, de, …; default en).

limit.description: Rows (1 credit each; at least 1 credit per call).

name: lex_export
title: Export corpus rows
